doc.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27

title: Comparing later cornet players; Lawrence Vega, Pacquet and Perkins
summary: Laine praises his cornet players, saying none played the time like them; he singles out Lawrence Vega, with Pacquet and Dave Perkins.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: That is, that is, that there is a shark. And I don't know what kind of music they play. I don't like that.
It ain't because this guy is sitting here that I'm going to.
That's right. It's a different kind of, Johnny plays a different kind of music.
It ain't because he's sitting here that I'm going to say it. But the same, same temperature, same time that he played cornet, all my cornet played it.
Same way. You said it sounded like Richie Brunus.

And then you're my own and all the same. Same way. Ain't no different about it. I never heard nobody play. You're better. I never heard nobody play a cornet time like that. Never. None of them. Almerico, Ossantos, Shockey. Oh, Shockey. Oh. I had Shockey a few times.
I told Dr. Sushaw on that too. I don't like it. I don't like that music. He said, you don't. I said, no, I don't like it, doctor. I don't like it. I don't like that music.

He said, you don't. I said, no, I don't like it, doctor. I don't like it. I said, I don't know what kind of time they play, but I don't like it. I said, I really don't like it. Have you played with Johnny Lala?
Yeah. Did you notice what sort of time he played music in? Well, that's the time we used to play in with Brownlee's band. Johnny Lala too, he played good.
He played good. Yeah. But Johnny, I had one cornet player, was grand.

Then I had another, just that quick, really. I see above the staff, Richie Brunus. Little Vega was the finest trumpet player that was in this man's town. Lawrence Vega. That kid could play a horn. Ragtime? Yeah. Yeah, Lawrence Vega. Brother, that boy, oh, he was young.

He played, that time he played with him and Pacquet and Dave Perkins. Huh. Well, Lawrence Vega played with you. Yeah. And Pacquet and Dave Perkins and you, I forgot who the others were, but anyhow, that's really, and you know Pacquet played good music. Pacquet played good music.
